watch.summary: The streamer watches a Valorant match where 100 Thieves wins and remarks that he needs to watch more of their matches specifically.

beats.what: Streamer watches player Cryo speak in a post-match interview clip.
Gameplay clip cuts in showing fast-paced round-winning plays.
Streamer admits he misses watching 100 Thieves Valorant and needs to watch more of them.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I need to watch some more Valorant, 100 Thieves at least, not Valorant in general.
watch.why: This clip is casual esport reaction commentary rather than a comedy beat. It contains no joke, overreaction, or punchline.
